meta.generated_from: park/results.json (placements, metrics, coverage curve), park/instance.py (layers, covered cells from the cached visibility), data/park_500m.npz
meta.note: MODELLED priority surface and line-of-sight visibility; SIMULATED fires and detection times from a simplified, uncalibrated spread model. Not a prediction of real fires or real detection times, and not a siting plan.

real.elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m), averaged to 500 m cells
real.land_cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m), as shares per 500 m cell
real.fire_detections: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m detections, 2012 to 2025, counted per 500 m cell
real.park_boundary: OpenStreetMap relation 2971358 (ODbL), as the share of each cell inside the park

modelled.priority: hand-weighted priority surface (fire history, fuel, dryness, spread, park value), not measured
modelled.visibility: line-of-sight from a 30 m mast with a 4 km range over the DEM, no vegetation or weather

simulated.detection_times: simulated fires on a simplified, uncalibrated spread model, not real detection times
